mapper.select: SELECT EMAIL_LOG_ID, EMAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_USERNAME, CONTENT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, SENT_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG WHERE EMAIL_LOG_ID = #{emailLogId}

SELECT EMAIL_LOG_ID, EMAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_USERNAME, CONTENT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, SENT_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG WHERE EMAIL_TYPE = #{emailType} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT EMAIL_LOG_ID, EMAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_USERNAME, CONTENT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, SENT_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG WHERE STATUS = #{status} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT EMAIL_LOG_ID, EMAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_USERNAME, CONTENT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, SENT_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG WHERE RELATED_TYPE = #{relatedType} AND RELATED_ID = #{relatedId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT EMAIL_LOG_ID, EMAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_USERNAME, CONTENT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, SENT_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG WHERE CREATED_AT BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT EMAIL_LOG_ID, EMAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_USERNAME, CONTENT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, SENT_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG WHERE STATUS = #{status}

SELECT EMAIL_LOG_ID, EMAIL_TYPE, SUBJECT, RECIPIENT_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_USERNAME, CONTENT, STATUS, ERROR_MESSAGE, RELATED_TYPE, RELATED_ID, SENT_AT, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY FROM TB_EMAIL_LOG WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC LIMIT #{limit}
